Definition: from G2056; a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked person):--goat.
BiblicalUsage: eríphion is the word for a kidling. It occurs just once, in Matthew.
TheologicalSignificance: I take eríphion as it stands — kidling — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
